content.text: Digital creators face significant challenges when trying to monetize their work in regions where platforms like PayPal or Stripe are unavailable. This problem is particularly pressing in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, where traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-6|payment]] gateways impose barriers that stifle creativity and revenue generation. Fortunately, Bitcoin payments offer a solution for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-notion-templates-crypto-explained-digital-creators-stripe-12|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-digital-products-africa-live-before-2|How to]] digital downloads without being burdened by high platform fees.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments allow digital creators to sell their products directly to consumers without relying on conventional platforms that charge exorbitant fees. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut from each sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference can be substantial; for example, if you sell a $97 product and make 100 sales a month, you retain an additional $921 by using Bitcoin payments instead of platforms like Gumroad.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads leverages decentralized technology to eliminate the middleman. Using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate the delivery of their digital products upon payment confirmation via NOWPayments, which handles the crypto transactions. This approach not only reduces transaction fees but also ensures that creators retain full ownership of their data and products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions with limited access to traditional payment systems. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this solution empowers you to establish a fully operational online store that bypasses restrictive platforms. By utilizing Bitcoin for transactions, you can effectively monetize your work without incurring high fees or relying on third-party services.
Retain 90% more revenue by switching to Bitcoin payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To set up Bitcoin payments for digital downloads, you need several key components: a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your website, a backend solution using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Each component integrates seamlessly, allowing for instant product delivery once payment is confirmed, creating a smooth experience for both creators and customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your Bitcoin payment system for digital downloads, start by selecting the appropriate hosting service. Next, set up your backend logic to manage transactions and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to handle the cryptocurrency payments, ensuring you choose the correct network for low transaction fees. Finally, load your products and test the entire process to confirm everything operates smoothly, allowing you to start selling immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your digital product delivery with seamless backend solutions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without relying on conventional platforms, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package includes all the essential blueprints and templates to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack effectively. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can use Bitcoin payments through NOWPayments for your ebook sales. This method eliminates reliance on traditional platforms and allows for direct transactions, increasing your revenue by reducing transaction fees.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Utilizing NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions offers the lowest fees, allowing you to keep more of your earnings. Setting up your own store with a sovereign commerce stack enables you to bypass platform fees entirely.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Absolutely. By creating your own digital storefront and using NOWPayments for transactions, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without incurring additional fees from platforms like Gumroad.
How do I automate delivery of digital products?

Automation can be achieved by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage product delivery upon payment confirmation. This ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly after completing the transaction.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital downloads?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept Bitcoin and many other digital currencies for your sales. This flexibility can attract a wider audience to your digital products.
